Local-first terminal database workbench

Usage: dexo [OPTIONS] [URL]
       dexo <COMMAND>

Commands:
  doctor       
  connections  
  completion   
  config       
  query        
  run          
  inspect      
  schema       
  export       
  import       
  explain      
  sessions     
  mcp          
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Arguments:
  [URL]
          Open the workbench connected to this URL, without saving it: postgres://user@host/db, mysql://…, mariadb://…, sqlite:///path/to/file

Options:
      --password-prompt
          Ask for the URL's password on the terminal instead of putting it in the URL, where shell history keeps it

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
